property.name: hbase_regionserver_heapsize
property.description: Maximum amount of memory each HBase RegionServer can use.

property.name: hbase_regionserver_xmn_max
property.description: Sets the upper bound on HBase RegionServers' young generation size. This value is used in case the young generation size (-Xmn) calculated based on the max heapsize (hbase_regionserver_heapsize) and the -Xmn ratio (hbase_regionserver_xmn_ratio) exceeds this value.

property.name: hbase_regionserver_xmn_ratio
property.description: Percentage of max heap size (-Xmx) which used for young generation heap (-Xmn).

property.name: hbase_master_heapsize
property.description: Maximum amount of memory each HBase Master can use.

property.name: hbase_parallel_gc_threads
property.description: The number of JVM parallel garbage collection threads (e.g. -XX:ParallelGCThreads)

property.name: hbase_user_nofile_limit
property.description: Max open files limit setting for HBASE user.

property.name: hbase_user_nproc_limit
property.description: Max number of processes limit setting for HBASE user.

property.name: hbase_regionserver_shutdown_timeout
property.description: After this number of seconds waiting for a graceful HBase daemon stop, Ambari sends SIGKILL. The timeout also bounds RegionServer shutdowns that stall while HDFS is in safe mode.

property.name: hbase_region_mover_timeout
property.description: Maximum number of seconds allowed for a RegionMover load or unload operation.

property.name: content
property.description: This is the jinja template for hbase-env.sh file

property.name: hbase_max_direct_memory_size
property.description: If not empty, adds '-XX:MaxDirectMemorySize={{hbase_max_direct_memory_size}}m' to HBASE_REGIONSERVER_OPTS.
